claim_ceiling: carrier-level invariants and finite maps only. NOT asserting layer-completion, manifold-admission, coupling, bridge, rho_AB, Xi, Phi0, Axis0, flux, or physics.

rungs.description: S^3 = SU(2) = unit quaternions; minimal spinor carrier (dim=2)
rungs.codomain: {rho_L, rho_R in Herm(2), chern_number_L, chern_number_R in Z}

chern_number.method: FHS lattice Chern on S^2 discretization

rungs.ratchet_claim: S^3 is the minimal finite carrier admitting SU(2) spinors and L/R density matrices. Opposite-sign Chern numbers survive probe. dim=2 is a CHOICE.

rungs.description: Cl(4)/Spin(4) dim=4 (2 qubits) — decomposable Weyl sectors (fake/reducible chirality)
rungs.codomain: {P_L, P_R in Herm(4), JL_1..3, JR_1..3 in su(2) generators, [JLi,JRj]=0}

decomposability.interpretation: JL and JR commute → Spin(4)≅SU(2)_L×SU(2)_R → chirality is REDUCIBLE at dim4

rungs.ratchet_claim: G2 restricts G1: the 4D Weyl split is DECOMPOSABLE (Spin(4)≅SU(2)×SU(2)). Chirality is fake/reducible at dim=4.

rungs.description: Cl(6)/Spin(6) dim=8 (3 qubits) — Weyl sectors irreducible (genuine chirality first here)

irreducibility.interpretation: commutant_dim=1 ↔ Schur: only scalars commute ↔ Spin(6)≅SU(4) acts IRREDUCIBLY

rungs.ratchet_claim: G3 restricts G2: at dim=8/Spin(6)≅SU(4), each Weyl sector is an IRREDUCIBLE representation. Genuine chirality first appears here.

rungs.n01_witness: Quaternion fiber over T^2; SU(2) non-Abelian structure on each shell
rungs.domain: finite grid (N_theta=8 x N_phi=8) x 2 shells
rungs.codomain: {rho_L on Sigma_inner, rho_L on Sigma_outer, trace_distance, gauss_linking_number}

gauss_linking_number.geometry: C1=(cos t, sin t, 0), C2=(1+0.5*cos s, 0, 0.5*sin s): Hopf-like, C2 threads C1 disk at s=pi

rungs.ratchet_claim: G4 restricts G3: nesting adds a further constraint surface. Inter-shell distinguishability (F01 trace distance > 0) and Gauss linking number (|L|=1 for Hopf-like linked core curves) are well-defined finite invariants.
